issues.title: Low contrast text in baseline card
issues.description: Prose text wrapping inline chips fails dark-theme legibility standards.
issues.evidence: Text such as 'Rates read from' and 'applied at checkout' is nearly invisible against the dark card surface.
issues.suggestion: Increase text color luminance to achieve at least 4.5:1 contrast.
issues.triageNote:
Verified real but page-authored: pair-010's

hardcodes text-neutral-300 around the chips, which inverts to near-black rgb(58 56 53) in dark (~1.6:1 on the bg-muted/20 card) — the eval page is off-limits to fix agents. Component atoms are self-contained (bg+text pairs invert together, ≥4.5:1 both themes; pair-084 dark audit clean). The demo carried the same anti-pattern (bg-neutral-900 canvas flips near-white in dark, prose neutral-300 flips near-black, FileRef link/path would drop to ~2.1:1) — fixed in demo.tsx with dark: counterparts (dark:bg-neutral-100 canvas, dark:text-neutral-600 prose) matching the ThoughtHeader demo convention; no dark: counterparts needed in the chip tokens themselves.
